Name: Shulamite
Summary: The Shulamite is the bride addressed in the Song of Solomon. No personal name is given for her in the text; 'Shulamite' is the title by which she is called. This is a titled profile for an unnamed-but-identifiable person, not a named individual.
KeyVerses: Song of Solomon 6:13; Song of Solomon 7:1
LifeLesson: Love that is named by a title, not a name, is still fully known.
